bohater.name: Hero
bohater.description: May join any unit. If this gives only part of the unit abilities that affect the whole unit, the opponent chooses whether they are active. May take Regroup tests for the whole unit, but the unit uses the Defence chosen by the opponent. Cannot be returned to play. Its size is treated as though it had half its Toughness.

ochroniarz.name: Bodyguard
ochroniarz.description: Hero. The unit may use your Defence. The controlling player cannot defeat other models in the unit.

zasadzka.name: Ambush
zasadzka.description: Does not deploy before the game. During the first round, instead of activating normally, deploy anywhere more than 2” from an enemy. Does not control objectives in the first round.

zwiadowca.name: Scout
zwiadowca.description: If you have not deployed any units without Scout or Aircraft before this unit, you may move this unit 6” once instead of deploying the next unit.

odwody.name: Reinforcements
odwody.description: Before deployment, divide units with this ability without Scout, Ambush or Reserve into two groups. The opponent chooses one group; its units gain Reserve.

instynkt.name: Instinct
instynkt.description: Always moves towards the nearest enemy and always attacks the nearest enemy.

nieruchomy.name: Immobile
nieruchomy.description: Cannot move after deployment and cannot become Pinned. When charging, may attack units within 3”.

niezgrabny.name: Clumsy
niezgrabny.description: Takes an additional difficult terrain test in difficult and dangerous terrain.

skok.name: Jump
skok.description: Ignores terrain and units while moving. Is still considered to pass through its destination point.

samolot.name: Aircraft
samolot.description: You cannot activate a unit without this ability while you have an unactivated unit with it. Its first action must be a Move of 30–36” in a straight line. Cannot control objectives, Charge, or be targeted by Charges or Indirect weapons. Does not block movement or line of sight for other units. Has cover, and units shooting at it have -12” range. Tall, Jump, Agile. If Pinned, discards that state and takes a difficult terrain test.

wysoki.name: Tall
wysoki.description: Checks line of sight as though on elevated terrain.

masywny.name: Sections
masywny.description: The whole unit is represented by one model with separate sections, which may take wounds beyond its maximum.

nieustraszony.name: Fearless
nieustraszony.description: Does not take Regroup tests while the unit is above half its starting Toughness.

niestrudzony.name: Tireless
niestrudzony.description: May perform the same action multiple times in an activation.

ucieczka.name: Escape
ucieczka.description: Before becoming Pinned or Exhausted, may make a Move.

stracency.name: Fanatics
stracency.description: After failing a Regroup test, take a difficult terrain test instead of the normal consequences.

furia.name: Fury
furia.description: When charging, natural rolls of 6 generate an additional normal hit.

przygotowanie.name: Planning
przygotowanie.description: If Prepared, gains +1 to hit rolls.

kontra.name: Counter
kontra.description: May counterattack before the charging unit makes its attacks; that unit is then no longer considered to be charging.

regeneracja.name: Regeneration
regeneracja.description: Before Regrouping, recover d3 wounds, up to the number lost during this activation.

dywersant.name: Saboteur
dywersant.description: If you are closer to the opponent’s deployment zone than the target unit is, before attacks are made the opponent chooses whether to double their number or become Pinned.

szpica.name: Vanguard
szpica.description: When attacking units that have not started their activation this turn, natural rolls of 6 generate an additional normal hit.

delikatny.name: Fragile
delikatny.description: A natural roll of 6 on a Defence test is not an automatic success.

niewrazliwy.name: Resilient
niewrazliwy.description: A natural roll of 5 on a Defence test is an automatic success.

maskowanie.name: Camouflage
maskowanie.description: Has cover when more than 2” from enemies.

waagh.name: Waagh!
waagh.description: If your unit is below half its starting Toughness and there is no other friendly unit with this ability within 12”, your attacks have -1 AP and attacks against you have +1 AP.

ostrozny.name: Cautious
ostrozny.description: If there are no enemies within 12” of this model’s unit, gains +1 to hit rolls.

tarcza.name: Shield
tarcza.description: Gains +1 to Defence tests while not Pinned.

okopany.name: Entrenched
okopany.description: Gains +1 to Defence tests while benefiting from terrain cover.

zdobywca.name: Conqueror
zdobywca.description: May ignore enemy units without this ability when checking mission objectives.

transport.name: Transport
transport.description: Friendly units with a combined Toughness of up to X may be transported by this unit. If the unit contains several models with Transport(X), add their capacities together. As an action, a transported unit may deploy: all its models must be placed within 2” of any models of the transporting unit. It is then no longer transported. A unit with all its models within 2” of the transporting unit may, as an action, be removed from the battlefield and become transported if there is sufficient capacity. If some models of the transporting unit are destroyed, transported units may temporarily exceed its capacity. If its last model is destroyed, excess wounds pass to the transported unit with the most models; all transported units must then immediately deploy as above and become Exhausted. If the transporting unit makes a double move or the initial Aircraft move, all transported units become Pinned. Transported units deploy with their transport in one activation and must have the same abilities affecting Deployment.

platforma_strzelecka.name: Firing Platform
platforma_strzelecka.description: As Transport(X), but units may Shoot as though at the transport’s position.

otwarty_transport.name: Open Transport
otwarty_transport.description: As Firing Platform(X), but units may become Exhausted to attack in melee together with the transport. They may also be attacked as though at the transport’s position and in cover.

straznik.name: Sentry
straznik.description: May Interrupt during the opponent’s activation to Shoot. Your unit then becomes Exhausted.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.description: Does not become Exhausted after counterattacking.

zemsta.name: Revenge
zemsta.description: Do not allocate wounds immediately; instead, allocate them before Healing during this unit’s activation. The opponent allocates wounds at the normal time, but cannot use wounds allocated earlier.

cierpliwy.name: Patient
cierpliwy.description: Gains +1 to Defence rolls if it has not started its activation this round.

odrodzenie.name: Regeneration
odrodzenie.description: At the end of your activation, recover half the unit’s lost Toughness points, rounding up. You may use them to return defeated models from this unit to play if they can be legally deployed.

rezerwa.name: Reserve
rezerwa.description: As Ambush, but within 12” of your table edge. If the deployment rules do not specify your edge, the opponent chooses it at the start of the first round.

wrak.name: Wreck
wrak.description: When defeated, the terrain you occupy counts as dangerous and difficult and provides cover for the rest of the battle.

roj.name: Swarm
roj.description: When this unit is targeted, ignore the weapon’s Deadly ability, but Blast(X) weapons always work at full effectiveness.

zwrot.name: Facing
zwrot.description: At the end of a move during its own activation, chooses which way it faces; it cannot change this outside its own activation. Its position defines four overlapping 180° zones: front, rear, left and right. If an attacking unit is entirely in the rear zone, this unit has -1 Defence. At least half its weapons must be assigned to a zone and may only attack targets entirely within that zone. The remaining weapons must attack a single unit.

mistrzostwo.name: Mastery
mistrzostwo.description: Each of your weapons has ability X.

mag.name: Caster
mag.description: Gains X power tokens at the start of each round, up to a maximum of 2X. Casters in a unit share their tokens. The army has a shared list of 6 abilities or attacks. When you could use one of them, spend its assigned number of tokens and take a test at its assigned difficulty. On a success, resolve its effect. One attempt per spell per activation.

przekaznik.name: Relay
przekaznik.description: Once per round, when a Caster within 12” casts a spell, they may cast it from your position with +1 to the roll.

koordynacja.name: Coordination
koordynacja.description: The opponent skips their next activation.

latanie.name: Patching Up
latanie.description: At the end of your activation, a unit within 2” recovers d3 wounds.

mobilizacja.name: Mobilise
mobilizacja.description: A unit within 12” is no longer Pinned.

przepowiednia.name: Prophecy
przepowiednia.description: Choose the enemy unit that will activate next, if possible.

presja.name: Pressure
presja.description: A unit within 12” is no longer Exhausted.

usprawnienie.name: Enhancement
usprawnienie.description: Interrupt so that a unit within 12” increases the AP of all its weapons by 1 until the end of the activation.

rozkaz.name: Command
rozkaz.description: Once per round, you may Interrupt so that a unit within 12” has, or does not have, ability X from that point until the end of the activation.

klatwa.name: Curse
klatwa.description: Once per round, you may Interrupt so that an enemy unit within 12” has, or does not have, ability X from that point until the end of the activation.

oznaczenie.name: Mark
oznaczenie.description: Once per round, you may Interrupt so that a friendly unit attacking a unit within 12” has, or does not have, ability X from that point until the end of the activation.

demoralizacja.name: Demoralisation
demoralizacja.description: Once per round, you may Interrupt so that an enemy unit within 12” takes a Regroup test.

aura.name: Aura
aura.description: Grant the selected ability to units in range. The 12” range variant is twice as strong.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: When a model in your unit gives a Command, it may choose a unit within 24” that also has Radio.

ociezalosc.name: Sluggishness
ociezalosc.description: Terrain within 12” counts as difficult for enemy units.

spaczenie.name: Corruption
spaczenie.description: Terrain within 12” counts as dangerous for enemy units.

ratownik.name: Medic
ratownik.description: During an activation in which your unit has taken wounds, heal one wound. At the end of its activation, if the unit has two Medics and is Prepared, heal one wound. Not cumulative.

meczennik.name: Martyr
meczennik.description: During your activation, you may be eliminated so that your unit recovers wounds equal to your Toughness.

rozprysk.name: Blast
rozprysk.description: Before Defence tests, multiply the number of hits by X, up to the number of models in the target unit.

zabojczy.name: Deadly
zabojczy.description: Inflict X wounds instead of one, up to the lowest Toughness in the unit if the defender allocates them, or the highest if the attacker allocates them.

niebezposredni.name: Indirect
niebezposredni.description: Does not require line of sight.

artyleria.name: Artillery
artyleria.description: Every unit within 12” of a friendly unit is in range of this weapon.

namierzanie.name: Targeting
namierzanie.description: Ignores cover and negative modifiers to hit rolls and range.

zuzywalny.name: Expendable
zuzywalny.description: May only be used once per game. Limit of one weapon type with this ability per unit.

rozrywajacy.name: Twin
rozrywajacy.description: Natural rolls of 6 to hit generate an additional normal hit.

przebijajaca.name: Piercing
przebijajaca.description: Each hit inflicts wounds equal to the result of the Defence die.

szturmowa.name: Assault
szturmowa.description: May be used to make melee attacks.

finezja.name: Finesse
finezja.description: You may treat the result of a successful hit roll as the result of a Defence roll.

brutalny.name: Brutal
brutalny.description: There are no automatic successes on Defence tests.

podkrecenie.name: Overdrive
podkrecenie.description: Makes twice as many attacks in the last round.

burzaca.name: Breakthrough
burzaca.description: Makes twice as many attacks if the target is within range of a mission objective.

unik.name: Predictable
unik.description: Makes twice as many attacks if the target is Pinned.

sterowany.name: Guided
sterowany.description: Before attacking with this weapon, for each associated marker, move it within weapon range of its current position, or attack from its position and discard it. Then make a normal attack or place a new marker within range. You may have two markers on the battlefield, shared by the whole unit. Place one marker after deployment.

porazenie.name: Shock
porazenie.description: When determining who won melee combat, wounds inflicted by this weapon count twice.

zguba.name: Doom
zguba.description: Count wounds received from such weapons. Models defeated by allocating the first wounds up to that number cannot return to play.

dezintegracja.name: Disintegration
dezintegracja.description: Natural rolls of 6 to hit inflict wounds without a Defence roll.
